notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - A New Badge, Puzzles, and Smoother Chaos
notes.content: [p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and this update focuses on making [i]Azooma Escape[/i] feel smoother, fairer, and even more rewarding to explore. From brand-new puzzles and improved tutorials to cleaner boss fights and a shiny new progress tracker (with brag-worthy badges), this patch polishes the chaos while adding fresh ways to test your skills. Whether you’re sneaking, sprinting, or surviving without a single death, there’s now more reason than ever to jump back in.[/p][p][/p][h1]New[/h1][list][*][p][b]Added Progress tracker visuals[/b]: clearer indicators for special collectibles and a new badge when you [b]finish a level without dying[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added different Background Music for some of the levels.[/p][/*][*][p]New puzzles added in some levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorial art for Throwing and Pushing.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Better[/h1][list][*][p][b]Smoke projectiles no longer make you invincible,[/b] only obscure enemy sight (useful for stealth).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss fights and enemy AI feel smoother[/b] and more predictable during phase changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI readability improved for collectibles[/b], throwing controls, and quest hints.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cutscenes and audio transitions[/b] refined so story beats feel cleaner.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual polish[/b]: better lighting, shadows, and several level touch-ups for fewer odd object interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bottomless Pits[/b]: decreased their radius so they are easier to avoid.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Fixed[/h1][list][*][p][b]Progression and checkpoint reliability[/b] improved so you’re less likely to get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues in the [b]first encounter with Amira[/b] so Players do not get stuck anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues in the [b]final boss Battle[/b] so that Players do not get stuck anymore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Throwing and pickup[/b] behaviours made more consistent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy detection tuned[/b] to prevent unfair catches from across the room.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Several UI and animation issues[/b] that affected clarity or responsiveness resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various level-sequencing and quest edge-cases addressed[/b] so objectives complete as expected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breakable Boxe[/b]s: removed their SFX as they caused some audio issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s it for now. Your feedback has already shaped two updates, and this is the third wave thanks to your input. Let us know what you think of the new additions, whether it’s the collectibles tracker, the boss fights, or the new puzzles, either here in the Steam discussions or over in our [url="https://discord.gg/C9XeCwNvBV"]Discord village[/url]. Every bit of feedback helps us make the game better for everyone.[/p]

notes.title: Update V1.2.0 is live!
notes.content:
[p]This update brings both [b]new toys to play with[/b] and much-needed polish across the board. From tossing cans straight out of vending machines to smoother boss fights, refined cutscenes, and fixes for those pesky softlocks, the game should now feel tighter, clearer, and more reliable from start to finish.[/p][p][i]~Amira[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]New[/h1][list][*][p]New throwable: Soda Can - find and throw cans from vending machines.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Better[/h1][list][*][p]Boss fights polished - smoother phase transitions and more reliable checkpoints/respawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Ul clarity improved - collectible counters and throwing UI are easier to read and use.[/p][/*][*][p]Several levels visually polished for smoother gameplay and fewer odd object interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Cutscene timing and audio transitions refined for cleaner story moments.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Fixed[/h1][list][*][p]Multiple progression-blocking softlocks (no more getting stuck in key areas).[/p][/*][*][p]Boss softlocks and death edge-cases that could halt progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Several collectible/quest checkpoint issues so progression completes reliably.[/p][/*][*][p]Various throwable pickup and throw behavior issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy catching you from afar in level 8[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s it for this round! 
Keep the feedback coming, and we’ll keep making Azooma Escape smoother, funnier, and more chaotic to play![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1: Escaping, but Smoother
notes.content: [p]We’ve polished the kabsa crumbs off the floor and tightened the locks on the party doors. This update brings cleaner audio, sharper cutscenes, and fewer “oops, I rolled into Uncle again” moments. Expect smoother escapes, juicier sound, and a few less ways to get stuck where you shouldn’t.[/p][p][/p][h3]Highlights:[/h3][list][*][p]New and updated cutscenes for Level 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Major audio improvements: boss & enemy music/SFX updated for richer, clearer sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Several level and gameplay fixes for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay:[/h3][list][*][p]Roll cooldown: a short cooldown has been added after dialogue to prevent accidental spamming of the roll.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved input responsiveness and controls for more consistent player input.[/p][/*][*][p]Jaser stun and fall behavior improved (shorter stun times; collider disabled while falling to avoid odd collisions).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels & Content:[/h3][list][*][p]Level 4: New cutscenes and fixes; boss ([spoiler]Shaddad[/spoiler]) music corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 1: Fixed Cat Key cutscene; Barker proximity/dialogue improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 7: [spoiler]Amira[/spoiler] boss improvements and adjustments to make the fight smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 14, 19, 21, 22: Fixed collectable rumble behavior so pickups consistently give feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 19: Checkpoints and collectable rumble issues fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 20: Fixed window animation and removed duplicate/hidden lights causing visual glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 23: Boss boundary and collider fixes to prevent getting stuck or leaving play area.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 24: Collider and sorting layer corrections to visuals and collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 3: Navigation mesh fixes to reduce pathfinding issues.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio & SFX:[/h3][list][*][p]Boss and enemy music updated (notably [spoiler]Shaddad[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Jinni[/spoiler] boss areas).[/p][/*][*][p]Many SFX updated or added: boss footsteps, GUI sounds, interactables (doors, manholes, vending machines, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]FMOD audio banks refreshed with the updated audio events.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI, Menus & HUD:[/h3][list][*][p]Pause menu button order updated for clarity (Settings now appears before Exit).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed button selection and navigation in the Special Collectible Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Credits updated (content and layout improvements).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug fixes & Polish:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed multiple typos and dialogue text (including character name fixes and volleyball/dialogue lines).[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial animations updated and hiding tutorial replaced with the new version.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several small visual/sorting/collider bugs across levels and prefabs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed roll/animation edge-cases where roll could stop unexpectedly after dialogue.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Localization & Text:[/h3][list][*][p]Various in-game text corrections and typo fixes across NPC dialogue and UI.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Quality-of-life:[/h3][list][*][p]Several stability and playflow improvements (cutscene fixes, navigation tweaks, prefab fixes).[/p][/*][/list]
